dedupe_keys.name: data for hydraulic model calibration using cryosat 2 observations in the zambezi catchment

description: Cécile Kittel and colleagues publish observations and model inputs for calibrating river hydraulics in the Zambezi catchment. The June 2021 archive contains CryoSat-2 water-level observations with simulated runoff at observation times, rainfall-runoff model parameters and a stand-alone run script. LISFLOOD-FP inputs describe channel widths, slopes, bed elevations and roughness for Upper Zambezi, Kabompo, Lungwebungo, Kafue and Luangwa subreaches. Sentinel-3A and 3B water-surface time series support evaluation, while synthetic observations explore 3, 20 and 40-centimetre uncertainty. Access is free under CC BY 4.0 through a ZIP archive with documented ASCII channel files. Exact observation periods, timestep and spatial resolution remain unknown from the summary. These inputs can test calibration sensitivity and river-flow simulations. Related catalogue record model-lisflood-fp supplies the hydraulic software; it does not contain these configured catchments. The archive and the linked toolbox were not downloaded or run.
